purpose: Teach: ヘタ/産ま/大雨/足ら/だらし/漂う/ふるさと/悪夢

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、トマトのヘタ、取らないと、食べにくいよ。
lines.en: Mom, you have to take off the tomato stem or it's hard to eat.
lines.style: Straightforward observation, matter-of-fact. Light, practical tone. The certainty of a child who has noticed something true. No performative emotion.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃん、田舎で、産まれ育ったのよ。
lines.en: Yes. Grandma was born and raised in the countryside, you know.
lines.style: Gentle explanation, turning slightly inward as if remembering. Warm but not overdone. A small smile in the voice—nostalgia without sadness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 明日、大雨って、ニュース、言ってたね、ママ。
lines.en: The news said there's going to be heavy rain tomorrow, didn't it, Mom?
lines.style: Sudden shift in topic, as if remembering something. Alert but not anxious. The quick way children change subjects. Bright voice, seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お小遣い、足らないの?お手伝いしてくれたら、増やすわよ。
lines.en: Is your allowance running short? If you help me out, I can give you more.
lines.style: Gentle pivot away from his worry. Warm, reassuring. Not a bargain exactly—more of an invitation. Quiet support underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お部屋、だらしないと、ママに怒られちゃう。
lines.en: My room's been a mess, and you're going to scold me about it, aren't you?
lines.style: Self-aware worry, slightly deflecting with humor. Soft anticipatory tone. Not whining—just matter-of-fact dread. A small kid bracing himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お焼き魚の香り、台所から、漂うね、いい匂い。
lines.en: The smell of the grilled fish drifting from the kitchen is so nice.
lines.style: Pause in the moment, noticing and savoring. Gentle, almost dreamy. Soft attack on the opening. The tenderness of noticing something ordinary that matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんのふるさと、夏休み、行きたいな!
lines.en: I really want to go to Grandpa's hometown for summer vacation!
lines.style: Genuine excitement breaking through. Bright, unguarded energy. The word 'really' carries the longing. A child's open yearning without restraint.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昨日、悪夢、見ちゃった、翔くん、寝言、いっぱい言ってたよ。
lines.en: Last night you had a bad dream and were talking in your sleep so much, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, watching-over tone. No alarm—just gentle observation. The voice of someone noticing and carrying a small worry quietly. Trailing off slightly at the end.
